title: Desktop engine bridge v1
description: The calls the page makes through window.duly.engine, and the replies from the desktop main process (SPEC-W2 section 2). Main checks each call against this contract, forwards it to the bundled engine over the private socket of SPEC-W1 with the token, and checks the engine's answer against this contract before the page sees it. The page never fetches api/ and never names a socket, a path, a port or a token. Every date the page shows comes from one of these replies, as an ISO date with a days_away integer; the page never adds, subtracts or counts days. Only the app's own page, in the window's main frame, may use the bridge. A message is one call or one reply.

compute_call.description: window.duly.engine.compute(case): the engine output for this case, as POST /v1/compute gives it. The case is any case: the student's own, the sample student's, or a copy changed for Try a change. Nothing is stored.

case.description: The case whose engine items and today the requests are dated from. A request that starts from an item needs the engine output of this case, and a request from today needs its time zone.

requests.description: The timers to date, as contracts/schedule.schema.json (K3) gives them. An empty list gives an empty answer.

schedule_call.description: window.duly.engine.schedule(case, requests): dates for the Loop module's timers, reminders, check-ins, digest and calendar file. Main forwards {case, requests} as the body of POST /v1/schedule (schedule.schema.json $defs/request). The engine dates every request; the page only names what to count from and by how much.

updates_call.description: window.duly.engine.updates(): the published updates bundled with the app, as GET /v1/updates gives them with no query. The page matches each update's affects selector against the engine's stages on the device; nothing about the case is sent.

refused.description: not_a_case: the case sent does not match case.schema.json, so nothing is forwarded. engine_unavailable: the engine is not running or its socket does not answer. engine_refused: the engine refused the call (for example a record kind or field the pack does not declare). engine_failed: the engine gave an error or no answer in time. not_an_answer: the engine's answer does not match this contract, so the page never sees it.

first_problem.description: For not_a_case, engine_refused and not_an_answer: where the message first fails, as a path and the rule it breaks. Never a value from the case.

today.description: Today as the engine read it for this case, the day every days_away is counted from.

dates.description: One answer for each request, in the order sent: the 200 body of POST /v1/schedule (schedule.schema.json $defs/response).

updates.description: Published updates only: each one passed publish_blockers. An update with no saved source never reaches this list.
